title: Sultanates take shape
description: On islands long settled by Africans, Arabs and Malagasy, rival sultanates consolidate and trade with the Swahili coast and Madagascar.

title: France takes Mayotte
description: The Malagasy-born ruler of Mayotte cedes his island to France, the first piece of the archipelago to pass to colonial rule.

title: French protectorates
description: France imposes protectorates on Grande Comore, Anjouan and Mohéli, bringing the last independent islands of the archipelago under its control.

title: Attached to Madagascar
description: The Comoros are annexed outright and governed as a dependency of the colony of Madagascar.

title: Overseas territory
description: The Comoros are detached from Madagascar and made an overseas territory of France with their own administration.

title: Independence referendum
description: Three islands vote overwhelmingly for independence but Mayotte votes to remain French, splitting the archipelago.

title: Independence declared
description: Prime Minister Ahmed Abdallah unilaterally declares independence; France eventually recognizes three of the islands and keeps Mayotte.

title: Denard ousts Abdallah
description: A dozen mercenaries under Bob Denard overthrow the president within weeks of independence, the first of his coups in the islands.

title: Mayotte confirms French rule
description: In a second referendum Mahorans again vote to remain part of France, which the Comoros continue to reject.

title: Denard restores Abdallah
description: Denard's mercenaries topple Ali Soilih and bring Ahmed Abdallah back to power; Soilih is killed within weeks.

title: Abdallah assassinated
description: President Abdallah is killed at his palace in murky circumstances after ordering Denard's presidential guard disarmed, and France flies the mercenaries out.

title: Denard's last coup fails
description: Denard lands with thirty mercenaries and seizes the government for a week until French commandos take the island back.

title: Flight 961 ditches offshore
description: Hijacked Ethiopian Airlines Flight 961 runs out of fuel and ditches in the shallows off Grande Comore, killing 125 of the 175 people on board.

title: Anjouan secession crisis
description: Anjouan and Mohéli declare they are leaving the union, opening a separatist crisis that runs for years.

title: Azali coup
description: Colonel Azali Assoumani takes power, promising to restore order and keep the islands together.

title: Union constitution
description: Voters approve a new constitution renaming the country the Union of the Comoros, giving each island wide autonomy and a rotating presidency.

title: Invasion of Anjouan
description: African Union and Comoran troops land on Anjouan and end the rule of Mohamed Bacar, who had refused to leave office; Bacar flees to Mayotte.

title: Constitutional referendum
description: Voters approve changes ending the rotating presidency, allowing Azali Assoumani to entrench himself in power.
